article_title: Dolly Parton free book scheme to expand in London

tasks.prompt: What is the main purpose of the Imagination Library expansion in London?
options: To give more young children regular access to free books at home
To replace London libraries with online reading apps
To sell books to families at a lower price
To teach only reception pupils how to use screens
tasks.correct_answer: To give more young children regular access to free books at home
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההרחבה נועדה לאפשר ליותר ילדים צעירים לקבל ספר חינם מדי חודש ולבנות הרגלי קריאה בבית.

tasks.prompt: How will the scheme's coverage change in London?
options: It will move from London to another city
It will expand from five boroughs to ten
It will operate in only one borough
It will cover every UK borough immediately
tasks.correct_answer: It will expand from five boroughs to ten
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת שהמיזם יתרחב מחמישה רובעים בלונדון לעשרה.

tasks.prompt: What does “eligible” mean when the article says 157,000 children will be eligible?
options: Required to pay for the books
Old enough to work in a library
Qualified or entitled to take part
Able to choose any adult novel
tasks.correct_answer: Qualified or entitled to take part
tasks.explanation_hebrew: eligible פירושו עומד בתנאים וזכאי להשתתף במיזם.

tasks.prompt: What does “take pressure off families” mean in Sedrick-Ugo's comment?
options: Make parents read more quickly
Prevent children from borrowing books
Ask families to donate every month
Reduce a financial or practical burden on families
tasks.correct_answer: Reduce a financial or practical burden on families
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר הקלה בעומס, כאן בעיקר בעלות של קניית ספרים ובהנגשתם לבית.

tasks.prompt: Why did Dolly Parton originally establish the Imagination Library?
options: In tribute to her father, who could not read or write
To promote a new album in London
To provide tablets to reception classes
Because the Postcode Lottery asked her to
tasks.correct_answer: In tribute to her father, who could not read or write
tasks.explanation_hebrew: פרטון הקימה את הספרייה בשנת 1995 כמחווה לאביה, שלא ידע לקרוא או לכתוב.

tasks.prompt: What does “universal” mean in the description of the scheme?
options: Only families below a fixed income can join
Every child in a participating area can register regardless of family income
Children must pass a reading test first
Only children already attending school receive books
tasks.correct_answer: Every child in a participating area can register regardless of family income
tasks.explanation_hebrew: universal מציין שהזכאות פתוחה לכל ילד באזור משתתף ואינה תלויה בהכנסת המשפחה.

tasks.prompt: Give two details showing how the monthly books affected Sienna and her family.
expected_points: She and her mother read together every day
The family built a home collection of books
Free books reduce the cost pressure of buying them
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני פרטים המיוחסים לעדותה של Harriet Sedrick-Ugo, בלי להציג אותם כמחקר על כל הילדים.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article connect free physical books with current concerns about early literacy?
expected_points: Frequent reading among children aged four and under reportedly fell from 64% in 2012 to 41%
Teachers reported some reception children do not know how to handle books
Some children try to swipe or tap paper pages like screens
Monthly books may create opportunities for shared reading at home
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד נגישות לספרים מודפסים עשויה לענות על החששות המתוארים, בלי לטעון שהמיזם כבר פתר אותם.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how the London expansion works, who can benefit and why organisers consider it important.
expected_points: The scheme posts one free book each month until a child's fifth birthday
Coverage will double from five to ten London boroughs
The expansion will make 157,000 children eligible and is funded by the Postcode Lottery
Any child in a participating area can register regardless of income
Organisers link it to declining frequent reading and children's familiarity with books
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב סיכום באנגלית בן ארבעה או חמישה משפטים, ולשמור על דיוק במספרים ובתנאי הזכאות.

tasks.prompt: Explain how the article presents a simple monthly book as having both educational and financial value.
expected_points: Regular books support shared reading and reading for pleasure
A home supply makes daily reading easier
Books can be expensive for families
Universal access avoids limiting support by income
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב פסקה באנגלית המבססת ערך חינוכי וערך כלכלי על פרטים מן הכתבה, בלי להבטיח תוצאה זהה לכל ילד.
